data.exact_reserve_text:
Change in estimates of prior year provisions 69,329 (134,768) (65,439)

Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain financial lines; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

During the current period, the Syndicate entered into a transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities. The transaction had a positive impact on the reported profit for the financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance of prior year claims liabilities (transaction)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities had a positive impact on reported profit for the financial year and affected prior year reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 69.329m (approximately 5.1% of opening gross claims outstanding) driven by adverse prior year development in certain financial/professional lines partially offset by favourable development across other classes. During the year the Syndicate completed a transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities which had a positive impact on reported profit.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year movement (gross) taken from Technical Provisions table 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross column). Narrative indicates mixed movements by class (adverse in financial lines, favourable in others) and mentions a reinsurance transaction affecting prior years. No explicit per-LOB gross prior-year movement amounts provided. Claims development triangle present but table formatting includes an 'and prior' aggregate column which was excluded; triangle rows alignment is somewhat ambiguous in the source PDF layout. LOB movement amounts are not quantified in the report.
